description:
Make every claim unit test and property test acquire and release leases through the entry points commands use, then delete the three lease APIs only tests call.

## Background

`ClaimCoordinator::acquire_claim`, `acquire_claim_with_reason` and `release_lease` (`crates/jit/src/storage/claim_coordinator.rs`) have no production caller. `jit claim acquire` uses `acquire_claim_synchronized`, and `jit claim release` evicts through the claims family's release-by-issue operation. The test-only methods are called by the coordinator tests, by the property tests in `storage/claim_coordinator_proptests.rs` (including the concurrency props through `acquire_claim_when_reached`), and by tests in `commands/claim.rs`, `commands/worktree.rs` and `commands/mod.rs`. The test-only `acquire_claim` evicts and then returns without persisting the eviction.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every coordinator test and property test acquires through `acquire_claim_synchronized` and releases through the production release path, and the concurrency property tests race the production acquire.
- [hard] REQ-02: The property tests still prove exclusive acquisition under concurrency and monotonically increasing sequence numbers.
- [hard] REQ-03: `ClaimCoordinator::acquire_claim`, `acquire_claim_with_reason` and `release_lease` no longer exist.
title: Test-only lease APIs are gone
